criteria.note: Accurate explanation of the study site, benchmark harness, build/deploy path, and empty database scaffold.
Concise and accurate Worker, SSR, hydration, localStorage, and headless-test flow.
Strong path and line evidence; the statement that automated coverage tests an OpenCode preview path is not established by the repository tests.
Three relevant risks with evidence and inference, including temporal model drift and machine-dependent adapters.
Well scoped, but it leaves the state source ambiguous: a localStorage-derived true-only badge would not satisfy the proposed unconditional SSR assertion.
Exact sections, concise response, no forbidden action, and zero workspace changes.

summary: Accepted and comparison eligible. Claude Code with DeepSeek produced a compact, well-evidenced report, but its UI test plan was less precise than the Codex and OpenCode responses.
